episodeTitle.en: The UX Research reckoning is here | Judd Antin (Airbnb, Meta)
episodeTitle.zh: 用户体验研究的反思——贾德·安丁（Airbnb、Meta）

guestBioOfficial.en: Judd Antin has spent 15 years leading research and design teams at companies like Yahoo, Meta, and Airbnb. His direct reports have gone on to lead user research at Figma, Notion, Slack, Robinhood, Duolingo, AllTrails, and more. In our conversation, we unpack the transformation that the user-research field is experiencing. Specifically: • Where user research went wrong over the past decade
guestBioOfficial.zh: 贾德·安丁在雅虎、Meta和Airbnb等公司领导研究与设计团队长达15年，其直接下属后来在Figma、Notion、Slack、Robinhood、Duolingo、AllTrails等公司领导用户研究工作。我们的对话深入解析了用户研究领域正在经历的变革，具体包括：• 过去十年间用户研究领域出现的误区

title.en: The UX Research reckoning is here | Judd Antin (Airbnb, Meta)
title.zh: 用户体验研究的反思——贾德·安丁（Airbnb、Meta）

summary.en: Judd coins "user-centered performance" to describe research done to signal customer obsession rather than to actually learn and change decisions. He argues the goal of research should be to falsify assumptions, not merely validate them. The episode warns against box-checking studies run too late to matter and offers a healthier philosophy for using research.
summary.zh: 贾德创造了"以用户为中心的表演"（user-centered performance）一词，用来描述那些只是为了彰显"以用户为中心"、而非真正为了学习并改变决策的研究行为。他认为，研究的目标应该是去证伪假设，而不只是验证它们。本期提醒人们警惕那些为走流程而在为时已晚时才进行的研究，并提出了更健康的用研理念。
